description: This file defines a data class and a composable function for managing and displaying a Base64-encoded image in an Android Jetpack Compose application. It handles decoding a Base64 string into an ImageBitmap and maintains state regarding whether the image failed to load.

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: A data class holding the decoded image and a flag indicating a loading failure.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: A composable function that manages the state of a Base64-encoded image, decoding it asynchronously and indicating failure if decoding does not succeed.
